summary: Hand-written fixes for the Mugs & Co demo shop, in the same shape Devin returns. Stock status gets a text label, the cart reflows at 200% zoom, checkout becomes a real link reachable by keyboard, the order total gets readable contrast, and the add-to-cart buttons get a 32px target.

fixes.title: Say the stock status in words, not only with a coloured dot
fixes.description: In-stock and out-of-stock items differ only by a green or red dot, which look identical with red-green colour blindness. The colour-blind user ordered the backordered mug. Add the status as text next to each dot.
fixes.code_change: In shop_page(), render the status as text next to the dot, e.g. In stock / Out of stock (ships in 6 weeks), and keep the dot as a decorative extra (aria-hidden="true").

fixes.title: Let the cart reflow at 200% zoom
fixes.description: The cart uses a fixed 1200px layout with horizontal overflow hidden and pins 'Proceed to checkout' to the right edge. At 200% zoom the button is cut off and cannot be scrolled to. Use a fluid layout and keep the button in the flow.
fixes.css: html, body { overflow-x: visible !important; } .layout { width: auto !important; max-width: 100% !important; } .checkout { position: static !important; display: inline-block !important; margin-top: 16px; }
fixes.code_change: In cart_page() CSS, replace `.layout { width: 1200px }` with `max-width: 1200px; width: 100%`, remove `overflow-x: hidden` from html/body, and place the checkout control in the normal flow instead of `position: absolute; right: 0`.

fixes.title: Make 'Proceed to checkout' a real link
fixes.description: 'Proceed to checkout' is a <div> with an onclick handler: it is not in the Tab order and Enter does nothing, so keyboard users cannot check out. Use a link (or a button) instead.
fixes.code_change:
In cart_page(), replace `
` with `Proceed to checkout` and add a visible :focus-visible style.

fixes.title: Give the order total readable contrast and size
fixes.description: The order total is 11px light grey (#c9c9c9) on white, a contrast ratio of about 1.6:1. WCAG requires 4.5:1. Low-vision users cannot read the most important number on the page.
fixes.code_change: In checkout_page() CSS, set `.total { color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700 }`.

fixes.title: Enlarge the add-to-cart buttons
fixes.description: The '+' buttons are 14x14px on 18px-high rows, so a slightly imprecise click adds the wrong product. WCAG 2.2 asks for targets of at least 24x24px.
fixes.css: .add { width: 32px !important; height: 32px !important; font-size: 18px !important; line-height: 28px !important; } td { height: 40px !important; }
fixes.code_change: In shop_page() CSS, set `.add { min-width: 32px; min-height: 32px }` and give rows enough height (e.g. `td { height: 40px }`), and give the button an accessible name such as aria-label="Add Blue Mug - Large to cart".
